resources.string: Save your display, followed rooms, and recognition choices to a file. Restore a saved file to replace those choices.

API keys and recordings are not included. Restoring does not reset recognition usage or change Android access. On a new or reset tablet, screen saver setup, accessibility access, YouTube Music microphone permission, and its tablet-only mute must be set up separately.

For YouTube Music recognition, enable the Farragut Clock bridge in Android accessibility settings and allow YouTube Music microphone access. The accessibility shortcut can stay off. The YTM mute is separate from this backup.
Open Android Settings > Accessibility to check the Farragut Clock bridge.
